narrative.heading: Education and community-building
narrative.text: Michael Waul's UCSF biography describes a commitment to elevating the voices of people underrepresented in medicine. It describes advising medical students, supporting trainee wellbeing, developing educational resources representing a wider range of skin colors, and using restorative justice to build community and address minority trainee burnout. These are his stated work and aims, not demonstrated patient outcomes or independently verified clinical credentials.
